caption: After install Selixer asked us to pick a plan; every plan starts with a 14 day free trial and no card.
The product sync worked: Selixer listed the same 23 products as our Shopify admin.
Orders stayed empty after two syncs, although the store had two paid orders worth $1,449.90.
The Catalyst trial came with 100 AI credits; top-ups start at $25 for 1,500 credits.
Billing showed the trial end date and that nothing is charged unless you choose a plan.
